business_problem: Poste Italiane needed to reinvent itself as physical mail declined and citizens expected more digital services, but that required a platform that could unify operations, launch new businesses quickly, and make interactions across channels more intelligent and personalized.
solution_summary: Poste Italiane and Accenture rebuilt the organization's service model around a cloud-ready digital backbone, then layered AI into the experiences delivered on top of it. The core platform migrated hundreds of critical applications to SAP S/4HANA on Microsoft Azure and introduced a data mesh architecture that unifies operations and supports rapid launch of new services. That digital core powers Poste Italiane's SuperApp, which brings banking, insurance, logistics, and energy services into one personalized experience used at national scale. AI assistants now resolve customer questions across digital touchpoints, AI agents surface real-time insights and tailored scripts for branch staff, physical AI and computer vision pilots support logistics, and gen AI tools help IT engineers search documentation and summarize architecture policies. The result is an AI-enabled national service platform that links cloud modernization, data integration, and customer interactions in one operating model.

data_flow: Operational data is unified through the SAP S/4HANA and data-mesh backbone running on Microsoft Azure, then exposed through the SuperApp and branch-service workflows. AI assistants use that digital core to answer customer questions across touchpoints, AI agents surface branch recommendations and scripts from the same data layer, and newer physical-AI and gen-AI use cases feed logistics and IT engineering processes connected to the shared platform.
business_outcome: Poste Italiane created a more scalable and personalized national service platform, used AI to improve both digital and branch experiences, supported faster rollout of new services, and extended its role from postal operator to multi-service platform for millions of citizens.
